description: A harmless gap: the test obligations no longer say that a certification issued long before a reservation date must be shown to be accepted. The behavior itself is stated (a certification stays valid until revoked); only what the tests cover is left open, which never shows at the boundary, so the change should land.

model.old: Tests and documentation do not expect or describe an expiry of certifications; a certification issued long before a reservation date is still accepted.
